title: route encoded export through the encoder surface (8K)

commit.merge_subject: merge: feat: encoded export through the encoder surface

tests: gradle assembleDebug testDebugUnitTest --rerun: 3049 tests, 0 failures. description: Encoded sources develop YUV on the GPU and draw straight onto the encoder input Surface, so an 8K clip never builds a 99 MB RGB frame. Branch feat-encoded-8k-surface-export, not merged until verified on the device.
added: EncodedExportPlanner: pure path decision and GPU memory budget
Mp4Session encoder-surface hooks, ExportPipeline session-owned surface mode with adopt fallback
changed: develop session defers the readback scratch + SSBO until a frame is read back (531 MB at 8K)
CPU fallback for an 8K frame refuses with a short message instead of an OutOfMemoryError
